subject: Film & Cinema
title: German Expressionism's Dark Shadows
description: A quick, practical guide to German Expressionism's Dark Shadows.

hook.text: After World War I, German filmmakers turned anxiety into a visual style.

buildup.text: Films like The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari used jagged sets and extreme shadows.

discovery.text: Distorted visuals externalized fear and madness — the sets felt as unstable as society.

twist.text: When the Nazis rose to power, many of these filmmakers fled to Hollywood.

climax.text: Their style shaped horror films, film noir, and Tim Burton's entire career.
